reviews.title: 1/5 Failure rate.
reviews.comment: I build PCs as a hobby and have ordered 10 of these over a year (750w and 650w). 2 of the 10 PCs I built with these units had PSU failures within 3 months of sale. One of those PSU failures shorted a motherboard. Only worth it if you need a temporary cheap option or you wanna take the risk to save a few bucks.
reviews.author: Bandit

reviews.title: Been good so far.. It really looks quality in the box for the money.
reviews.comment: I haven't been using them long.. But for my budget builds that need 750w. These are super well presented and I haven't had any problems yet..(every one of them comes with a tester.. kind of neat)  It has a modular connection for  12VHPWR Adapter 2x 8-pin for Nvidia cards but no modular cable is supplied for that connector, so hmmm, kinda wish it came with that.. Cause if I have to buy it, I would only do so if the card doesn't have the adapter cable for some reason. But I would be wary of just buying some off brand connector to plug into the P/S, so it starts to become a pointless feature where I would be back to just buying a 2x8pin adapter.
